observations: Photo 0: Sealed/taped outer cardboard shipping box with 'Nikon D750' printed on it, sitting on a sofa; a Nikkor lens box labeled '50' is beside it; a gimbal/stabilizer product box is in the background.
Photo 1: Interior of the D750 box showing only printed paper manuals ('D750 User's Manual', apparel/warranty booklet) and another branded box (Zhiyun gimbal) behind, no camera body visible.
Photo 2: A different box containing items wrapped in bubble wrap; shapes are indistinct, could be a lens hood or body, but no camera, lens glass, mount, buttons, screen, or serial number is visible.
No photo shows the actual camera body unwrapped, powered on, with lens mount, LCD screen, shutter count, or serial number plate.
A gimbal/stabilizer (Zhiyun-style) box appears in the background, not mentioned in the seller's text, raising a question about what is actually included.

claims.evidence: No camera body, serial number, or region markings are visible in any photo; only the outer box is shown.
The actual device is never shown unboxed or unwrapped; only bubble-wrapped contents are visible in photo 2.
No power-on shot, LCD screen activation, shutter count, or test image shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Box may not contain an actual Nikon D750 body (empty-box or mismatched-item risk), since no camera is visible in any photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the body removed from packaging, showing the Nikon logo, lens mount, and LCD screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified existence; treat as high risk, not at full body value

risks.risk: Shutter count and sensor condition unknown, critical for D750 pricing given known shutter-related recall issues on early units.
risks.proof: A photo/screenshot of the shutter count from camera menu or a sample test shot with EXIF data.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst-case high shutter count / unverified condition

risks.risk: Serial number not shown, so authenticity and import/grey-market status cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the serial number plate on the body base matching the box label.

risks.risk: Unclear what is actually included: body only, or body plus 50mm lens and gimbal seen in background boxes.
risks.proof: A single photo laying out all items together (body, lens, gimbal, manuals) side by side.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, accessories not counted

risks.risk: No functional test shown (power on, screen, shutter actuation).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the camera powering on and shutter firing.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera body fully unboxed, showing front (lens mount), top (controls), and back (LCD screen) clearly.
Close-up photo of the serial number on the body base.
Video or screenshot of the camera powered on, showing menu shutter count.
A single photo showing all items being sold together (body, lens, gimbal if included) to clarify the bundle.
response.reason: All three photos show only packaging, manuals, and bubble-wrapped contents; the actual camera body, its screen, mount, and serial number are never shown, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to a confirmed physical item.
